integrity: Result proven by a finite permutation-orbital argument, not certified by finite tests. The principal 2023 primary preprint was read in its introduction, classification/Burnside statements and early structural sections; later sections were inaccessible in this review. Priority risks from more general orbit-stabilizer/colored-digraph literature remain.
scientific_limitations: Geometric reduced symmetry locus and ordinary automorphisms only; n >= 4 and full-support invertible normalized matrices. Asymptotic is at fixed n for q tending through prime powers, excludes empty parameter sets. No classification of all finite-field stabilizer distributions, nonperfect algebras, or nonreduced automorphism group schemes.
title: Prime-order symmetry components of full-support evolution algebras
